raw:
<explanation>
Structured prompt format with labeled fields ("Record:", "Task:") establishes a pattern of concise, factual data entries for a language model to process.

The "Record" contains a complete narrative example ("A man..."), and "Task: Predict next token" signals the model should anticipate continuation or completion of the example.

"Record complete." is a closing delimiter phrase, likely followed by a period or end marker, signaling the end of the instruction block.
"Recorded in Chinese-style bracket format: [example]. Task: Predict next token. Record complete." — the final phrase "Record complete." functions as a closing statement, suggesting the next token may be a period, newline, or a new instruction/response prompt.
"Present a brief fictional scenario... [example]. Record complete." — the closing phrase "Record complete." mirrors the opening.</explanation>
